articles.title: Figma MCP: Run Weave Tools, Right from Your Favorite Agent
articles.summary: Figma Weave tools can now be run from external AI clients like ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor through the Figma MCP server. Users can describe a task, such as running a Brand mockup tool, and the agent finds it, executes it, and returns results directly in the conversation. This lets users stay within their chat workflow while preserving context like prompts, images, and brand guidelines.

articles.title: WhatsApp's next iPhone update could make searching chats much easier
articles.summary: WhatsApp is testing a new in-chat search button for iPhone that would make it much easier to find older messages without navigating through multiple menus. Instead of opening the chat info screen to access search, users would be able to start searching directly from the conversation, with the button appearing when scrolling through older messages. The change streamlines a common task and reflects WhatsApp's ongoing efforts to reduce friction in everyday interactions.

articles.title: Anthropic to Start Watermarking Claude-Generated Text, Images
articles.summary: Anthropic will embed an invisible watermark in text and images generated by Claude, aligning it with the EU AI Act's voluntary Code of Practice. Text watermarking applies to Claude models released after August 2nd, and the mark persists when text is copied to other applications or edited. Images will be marked using C2PA metadata, though detection may fail on short or heavily edited text snippets.

articles.title: Is there a retirement crisis in the creative industry?
articles.summary: Many senior creatives are considering early retirement due to economic uncertainty, shrinking margins, and concerns about AI reducing demand for production-focused creative work. However, retirement is not a guaranteed solution and human expertise remains valuable in areas such as strategy, branding, problem-solving, and specialised craft. The most resilient creatives will be those who adapt their skills and shift their value from execution to higher-level thinking and decision-making.

articles.title: Taste is All That's Left
articles.summary: With AI collapsing the distance between idea and working artifact, the friction that once rationed output and trained judgment has disappeared. Taste, the wordless verdict on what is worth keeping, is the one part of the work machines cannot perform. The scarce act is no longer making but choosing what deserves to exist.

articles.title: Going from Senior to Staff Designer Isn't about Doing the Best Work Anymore
articles.summary: Moving from Senior to Staff or Principal designer is a shift from shipping the best work to setting direction. The harder skill is externalising taste so other designers can act on it, rather than developing more of it. Six practices are offered, including writing principles instead of preferences and pre-stating review criteria.

articles.title: A UX Design Perspective on Improving AI Safety
articles.summary: A lawsuit over a teenager's death after months of conversations with a Character.AI companion bot frames the limits of on-screen disclosures. State laws such as Washington's HB 2225 now mandate repeated non-human disclosure and self-harm protocols, which risk becoming banner blindness. A duty of care is proposed, with public reporting on how often safeguards fail rather than descriptions of perfect guardrails.

articles.title: Thissaway refreshes historic golf resort The Belfry following major expansion
articles.summary: The Belfry Hotel & Resort has unveiled a new brand identity by Thissaway to coincide with major investments in its facilities, including a new conference centre and wellness hub. The rebrand is built around the historical meaning of a belfry—a bell tower that brings people together—which reflects the resort's role as a destination for celebrations, events, and shared experiences. The updated identity features a refined bell symbol, contemporary serif typography, an expanded colour palette, and a flexible system that extends across the resort's spa, club, dining venues, signage, digital channels, and marketing materials.

articles.title: Studio Dial Weaves Motion Design into Cocktail Menus, Afghan Textiles and City Plans
articles.summary: London studio Dial works across branding and coded tools for clients including Google, Azra, and Inner City Consulting.

articles.title: The Myth of the Accessible Typeface
articles.summary: Accessibility in typography has become clouded by misinformation, quick-fix checklists, and questionable claims, rather than being treated as a genuine design consideration.

articles.title: iOS 27 beta 5 adds new app icons for Siri, Safari, and more
articles.summary: iOS 27 beta 5 introduces updated icons for Siri, Safari, Settings, Preview, and other system apps as Apple continues refining its Liquid Glass design ahead of next month's release.
